tools.name: create_media_player
tools.description: Create a new Media Player asset (UMediaPlayer) with optional linked Media Texture and File Media Source.

asset_path.description: Content path for the new Media Player (e.g. '/Game/Media/MP_CinematicPlayer')

create_texture.description: If true, also creates a linked Media Texture

texture_asset_path.description: Custom content path for the Media Texture if create_texture is true

create_source.description: If true, also creates a linked File Media Source

source_asset_path.description: Custom content path for the File Media Source if create_source is true

file_path.description: Optional file path on disk for the File Media Source

tools.name: create_media_texture
tools.description: Create a new Media Texture asset (UMediaTexture) optionally bound to a Media Player.

asset_path.description: Content path for the new Media Texture (e.g. '/Game/Media/MT_CinematicTexture')

media_player.description: Content path of the Media Player to bind to this texture

tools.name: create_file_media_source
tools.description: Create a new File Media Source asset (UFileMediaSource).

asset_path.description: Content path for the new File Media Source (e.g. '/Game/Media/MS_IntroVideo')

file_path.description: File path on disk for the video/audio file

tools.name: configure_media_player
tools.description: Configure playback settings (looping, shuffle, active media source) on an existing Media Player asset.

asset_path.description: Content path of the Media Player asset to configure

media_source.description: Content path of a Media Source asset to open

tools.name: get_media_info
tools.description: Retrieve information and playback state of a Media Player, Media Texture, or Media Source asset.

asset_path.description: Content path of the Media asset to inspect

tools.name: configure_sound_wave_cue
tools.description: Configure properties (looping, volume, pitch) of a SoundWave asset and optionally instantiate a USoundCue asset with a USoundNodeWavePlayer and USoundAttenuation.

SoundWaveAsset.description: Object path of target SoundWave asset (e.g. '/Game/Audio/SW_Explosion')

CueAssetPath.description: Optional content path for new USoundCue asset (e.g. '/Game/Audio/SC_Explosion')

AttenuationAssetPath.description: Optional object path to USoundAttenuation asset
